claims.claim: Phantom is rolling out Kalshi-powered prediction markets to US users through a partnership with KalshiEx, after KYC and a Kalshi account link.
claims.episode_span: Phantom is opening Kalshi event contracts to users in the United States inside the Phantom app
claims.source_title: BREAKING: Phantom Crypto Wallet Enables Kalshi Prediction Market Trading for US Users
claims.supporting_quote: U.S. users will trade event contracts directly in the Phantom app after completing Kalshi’s KYC process and linking or creating a Kalshi account.

claims.claim: Trades are primarily funded with Phantom’s CASH stablecoin, and Phantom does not take custody of user funds.
claims.episode_span: Trades are funded primarily with Phantom's CASH stablecoin
claims.source_title: BREAKING: Phantom Crypto Wallet Enables Kalshi Prediction Market Trading for US Users
claims.supporting_quote: Trades will primarily be funded with Phantom’s CASH stablecoin. Phantom acts as a non-custodial interface and does not take custody of user funds.

claims.claim: Users become direct members of Kalshi, a CFTC-registered designated contract market and derivatives clearing organization.
claims.episode_span: users become direct members of Kalshi, described in the announcement as a CFTC-registered designated contract market
claims.source_title: BREAKING: Phantom Crypto Wallet Enables Kalshi Prediction Market Trading for US Users
claims.supporting_quote: Users become direct members of Kalshi, a CFTC-registered Designated Contract Market and derivatives clearing organization.

claims.claim: Kalshi shares a portion of exchange fees with Phantom on contracts traded via the Phantom interface.
claims.episode_span: Kalshi shares with Phantom a portion of the exchange fees
claims.source_title: BREAKING: Phantom Crypto Wallet Enables Kalshi Prediction Market Trading for US Users
claims.supporting_quote: Kalshi shares with Phantom a portion of the exchange fees Kalshi receives on the event contracts traded via the Phantom interface.

claims.claim: Max Crowley said Phantom did the regulatory work up front.
claims.episode_span: Max Crowley, Kalshi's vice president of business development, said Phantom did the regulatory work up front
claims.source_title: BREAKING: Phantom Crypto Wallet Enables Kalshi Prediction Market Trading for US Users
claims.supporting_quote: “Phantom did the regulatory work up front, and it’s a model for how prediction markets can reach more people,” said Max Crowley, VP of Business Development at Kalshi.

claims.claim: The CFTC granted Phantom no-action relief in March 2026 allowing non-custodial interfaces to connect users to registered exchanges without registering as brokers.
claims.episode_span: CFTC no-action relief for Phantom in March 2026, letting non-custodial interfaces connect users to registered exchanges without registering as brokers
claims.source_title: BREAKING: Phantom Crypto Wallet Enables Kalshi Prediction Market Trading for US Users
claims.supporting_quote: The launch follows CFTC no-action relief granted to Phantom in March 2026. The regulator allowed non-custodial interfaces to connect users to registered exchanges without registering as brokers.

claims.claim: Phantom’s earlier Kalshi integration in December was restricted for U.S. users, and in June new non-U.S. positions moved to World Prediction Markets.

claims.source_title: BREAKING: Phantom Crypto Wallet Enables Kalshi Prediction Market Trading for US Users
claims.supporting_quote: Phantom first introduced prediction markets via a Kalshi integration in December last year. However, the feature was restricted for U.S. users and several other jurisdictions.
